# Niraj Kumar Gupta · Teaching Hub

> Free, openly accessible university teaching material written by Niraj Kumar Gupta, Senior Engineer at NDCL (Nepal) and lecturer. Each lesson is a self-contained interactive HTML page with explanations, worked examples, diagrams and practice questions.

Content may be quoted and cited with a link to the lesson page. Terms: https://gupta-niraj.com.np/privacy.html

## Site

- [Home](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/): profile, experience, education and research of Niraj Kumar Gupta
- [CV (PDF)](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/assets/Niraj_Kumar_Gupta_CV.pdf)
- [Teaching Hub](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/): all subjects

## Digital Logic (BT102CO)

Course page: https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic.html — written by Niraj Kumar Gupta, taught at Gateway Professional College (Purvanchal University). Reference book: Digital Logic and Computer Design by M. Morris Mano.

### Unit 1: Number Systems

Binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal; conversions, complements and binary codes.

- [Unit 1 · Number Systems](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic/unit-1-number-systems.html): Interactive notes with an MCQ practice test

### Unit 2: Boolean Algebra & Logic Gates

Boolean theorems and functions, logic gates, canonical forms and logic families.

- [Unit 2 · Boolean Algebra & Logic Gates](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic/unit-2-boolean-algebra-and-logic-gates.html): Interactive notes, lab connection and quiz

### Unit 3: Simplification of Boolean Functions

Minterms and maxterms, two- to four-variable K-maps, prime implicants, SOP and POS.

- [Unit 3 · Simplification of Boolean Functions](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic/unit-3-simplification-of-boolean-functions.html): Step-by-step ladder with K-map practice

### Unit 4: Combinational Logic

Adders and subtractors, code conversion, multilevel NAND/NOR circuits, XOR and parity.

- [Unit 4 · Combinational Logic](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic/unit-4-combinational-logic.html): Interactive notes with a problem bank

### Unit 5: Combinational Logic with MSI & LSI

Parallel and BCD adders, comparators, decoders, encoders, multiplexers, ROM and PLA.

- [Unit 5 · Combinational Logic with MSI & LSI](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic/unit-5-combinational-logic-msi-lsi.html): Interactive notes with a problem bank

### Unit 6: Sequential Logic

Flip-flops (RS, D, JK, T, master-slave), state equations and state reduction.

- [Unit 6 · Sequential Logic](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic/unit-6-sequential-logic.html): Interactive notes with a problem bank

### Unit 7: Registers & Counters

Shift registers, SISO/SIPO/PISO/PIPO, synchronous and asynchronous counters, ring and decade counters.

- [Unit 7 · Registers & Counters](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/digital-logic/unit-7-registers-and-counters.html): Interactive notes with a problem bank

## Switching & Routing (NCS 485)

Course page: https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing.html — written by Niraj Kumar Gupta, taught at UniGlobe College (Pokhara University).

### Unit 1: Introduction to Switching & Routing

Where switches and routers sit in a network, IP addressing review, and first steps on the Cisco CLI.

- [Unit 1.1 · Role of Routers & Switches](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-1-1-routers-and-switches.html): Computer network basics review: OSI, TCP/IP, Layer 2 vs Layer 3
- [Unit 1.2 · IP Addressing Review](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-1-2-ip-addressing-review.html): Classful vs classless addressing and network design
- [Unit 1.2 · Switching vs Routing](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-1-2-switching-vs-routing.html): Frames, packets and forwarding, with an ARP/CAM walkthrough
- [Unit 1.3 · Cisco IOS & CLI Basics](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-1-3-cisco-ios-cli-basics.html): CLI modes, memory and the switch boot process
- [Lab 1 · Introduction to Packet Tracer & a Simple LAN](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-1-lab-simple-lan.html): Problem statement & solution · Build, cable and address a small LAN, then test it
- Download: [IP subnet & network design calculator](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/ip-network-design-calculator.xlsx)
- Download: [Lab 1 · Building a simple LAN](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-1-simple-lan.pkt)

### Unit 2: Switch Fundamentals & Configuration

How a switch forwards frames, and how to configure, secure and verify it.

- [Unit 2.2 · Switching Methods](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-2-2-switching-methods.html): Store-and-forward, cut-through and fragment-free
- [Unit 2.3 · MAC Address Table & Frame Forwarding](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-2-3-mac-address-table.html): How a switch learns, floods and forwards
- [Unit 2.3 · Basic Switch Configuration](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-2-3-basic-switch-setup.html): Hostname, management IP, console, VTY and SSH
- [Unit 2.4 · Managing & Verifying Switch Configuration](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-2-4-managing-switch-configuration.html): Show commands, saving and backing up configurations
- [Lab 2 · Initial Switch Configuration & Remote Access](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-2-lab-switch-config-remote-access.html): Problem statement & solution · Hostname, passwords, management IP, SSH and connectivity tests
- Download: [Lab 2 · Switch configuration and remote access](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-2-switch-config-remote-access.pkt)
- Download: [Switch configuration cheat sheet](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/switch-config-cheat-sheet.pdf)

### Unit 3: VLANs

Breaking one switch into many broadcast domains, trunks and inter-VLAN routing.

- [Unit 3.1 · VLAN Concepts & Configuration](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-3-1-vlan-concepts.html): Purpose, membership and configuration of VLANs
- [Lab 3A · Inter-VLAN Routing with a Layer 3 Switch](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-3-lab-3a-layer3-switch.html): Problem statement & solution · SVIs and IP routing on a multilayer switch
- [Lab 3B · VLANs, Trunks & Router-on-a-Stick](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-3-lab-3b-router-on-a-stick.html): Problem statement & solution · VLANs, 802.1Q trunks and subinterfaces on one router
- Download: [Lab 3A · Inter-VLAN with Layer 3 switch](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-3b-intervlan-layer3-switch.pkt)
- Download: [Lab 3B · Router-on-a-stick](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-3-router-on-a-stick.pkt)

### Unit 4: Static Routing

How a router decides where a packet goes, and how to tell it by hand.

- [Unit 4 · Static Routing](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-4-static-routing.html): Static and default routes in multi-router topologies
- [Lab 4 · Static & Default Routes](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-4-lab-static-default-routes.html): Problem statement & solution · Static and default routes across a multi-router topology
- Download: [Lab 4 · Static and default routes](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-4-static-default-routes.pkt)

### Unit 5: Distance Vector Routing

Routers sharing what they know with their neighbours: RIP and its limits.

- [Unit 5 · Distance Vector Routing (RIP)](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-5-distance-vector-rip.html): RIP versions, updates, timers and loop prevention
- [Lab 5 · RIPv2 Routing](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-5-lab-ripv2.html): Problem statement & solution · Configure RIPv2, verify updates and debug RIP routing
- Download: [Lab 5 · RIP v2](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-5-ripv2.pkt)

### Unit 6: Link-State & Hybrid Routing

OSPF and EIGRP in theory and in the lab.

- [Unit 6 · Link-State & Hybrid Routing Protocols](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-6-link-state-and-hybrid-routing.html): OSPF concepts, areas and the SPF algorithm
- [Unit 6.3 · EIGRP & Comparing RIP, OSPF, EIGRP](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-6-3-eigrp.html): EIGRP fundamentals with a design comparison matrix
- [Lab 6 · OSPF Implementation](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-6-lab-ospf.html): Problem statement & solution · Single-area OSPF in a multi-router topology
- [Lab 6B · EIGRP Implementation](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-6-lab-eigrp.html): Problem statement & solution · Basic EIGRP setup and verification
- Download: [Lab 6 · OSPF single area](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-6-ospf-single-area.pkt)

### Unit 7: Advanced Switching

Redundant switched networks: STP, Rapid PVST+, port security and EtherChannel.

- [Unit 7 · Advanced Switching](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-7-advanced-switching.html): STP, Rapid PVST+, port security and EtherChannel
- [Lab 7 · Switching Lab Series](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-7-lab-series.html): Problem statement & solution · VLANs, STP, port security, EtherChannel and trouble tickets
- Download: [Lab 7 · STP, port security, EtherChannel](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-7-stp-port-security-etherchannel.pkt)

### Unit 8: WAN, ACL & NAT

Connecting sites over WAN links, filtering traffic and sharing public addresses.

- [Unit 8 · WAN, ACL & NAT](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-8-wan-acl-nat.html): PPP/HDLC, access control lists and network address translation
- [Lab 8 · WAN, ACL & NAT Lab Series](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/unit-8-lab-series.html): Problem statement & solution · PPP/HDLC, ACL filtering and NAT for internet access
- Download: [Lab 8 · PPP/HDLC, ACL and NAT](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/downloads/lab-8-ppp-hdlc-acl-nat.pkz)

### Lab Companion

Commands, a practice checklist and self-test questions for every lab, stage by stage.

- [Lab Companion · Command Cheat Sheet](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/lab-command-cheat-sheet.html): Every command for Labs 1–8, with verification and troubleshooting
- [Lab Companion · Practice Checklist](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/lab-practice-checklist.html): Tick off each stage from a clean start to backup and recovery
- [Lab Companion · Command Question Bank](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/switching-routing/lab-question-bank.html): Questions by lab to test yourself on commands and output

## Other subjects

- [C Programming](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/c-programming.html): C Programming study material — MCQs, conceptual Q&A, video lectures, and downloadable notes. Based on CSC115 coursework.
- [Cloud Computing](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/cloud-computing.html): Cloud Computing (Microsoft Azure) study material — MCQs, Q&A, video lectures, and notes. Based on Unit 28, Sunderland University.
- [Basic Electrical Engineering](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/electrical-engineering.html): Basic Electrical Engineering — waveforms, AC/DC fundamentals, MCQs, Q&A, videos and downloadable notes.
- [AI / ML / Deep Learning](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/ai-ml.html): AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning study material — MCQs, Q&A, lectures, and notes. Includes original GAN research.
- [Python & Data Science](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/python-data-science.html): Python and Data Science study material — MCQs, conceptual Q&A, video lectures, and downloadable notes covering NumPy, pandas, visualisation, and ML workflows.
- [WEKA — Data Mining](https://gupta-niraj.com.np/teaching/weka.html): WEKA software study material — MCQs, conceptual Q&A, video lectures, and notes covering Explorer, classifiers, clustering, and ARFF format.
